system.name: Mugi
system.one_liner: a value-level-parallelism (VLP) hardware architecture that accelerates nonlinear operations and GEMM in LLM inference

components.name: Off-chip memory
components.role: stores weights and inputs before they are streamed on-chip

components.name: iSRAM
components.role: on-chip input SRAM buffer, double-buffered to hide access latency

components.name: wFIFO
components.role: weight FIFO feeding each PE row

components.name: CNT
components.role: counter that generates the temporal signal used for mantissa subscription

components.name: iAcc
components.role: input accumulator staging data from iSRAM before the PE array

components.name: iFIFO
components.role: input FIFO buffering staged values before the PE array

components.name: SW
components.role: switch/steering logic that routes staged input values

components.name: TC
components.role: temporal converter that turns an approximate mantissa into a temporal signal

components.name: PE
components.role: processing element performing pipelined temporal subscription via an AND gate, arranged in rows and columns

components.name: PP
components.role: post-processing unit combining subscribed temporal results with the sign bit

components.name: oAcc
components.role: output accumulator that simultaneously sums exp results for the softmax numerator

components.name: oFIFO
components.role: output FIFO buffering final results out of the array

components.name: oSRAM
components.role: output SRAM storing the accumulated exp sum and final results

components.name: M-proc
components.role: mantissa-processing unit handling field split and value reuse phases

components.name: E-proc
components.role: exponent-processing unit that subscribes the correct LUT-vector exponent, feeding Max/Min and Clamp logic

components.name: Vec
components.role: vector multiplication array that divides exp results by the reciprocal of the softmax sum

flows.what: temporal signal pipelined via the T register
results accumulated for the softmax sum

content.key_idea: Mugi fuses the four VLP approximation phases and softmax-specific hardware into one double-buffered systolic architecture that maximizes resource reuse across nonlinear approximation and GEMM computation
content.reading_order: main panel (a) left to right, following data from off-chip memory through the PE array to the output SRAM/vector unit; sub-panels (b)-(h) around it zoom into individual circuit blocks referenced by letters

encoding.color_means: yellow = phase 1 (field split), red = phase 2 (value reuse), green = phase 3 (mantissa temporal subscription), blue = phase 4 (exponent temporal subscription) of VLP approximation; purple = hardware for mapping softmax; gray = additional hardware for GEMM
encoding.emphasis: the same four-color phase coding used in the algorithm walkthrough (Figure 3) is mapped directly onto the hardware blocks, letting the reader trace each VLP phase to its physical circuit
reusable_patterns: systolic PE-array accelerator diagram with color-coded functional phases and zoomed circuit-level inset panels
weaknesses: very high panel and label density (8 panels, 128 text boxes) makes the overall dataflow hard to follow without also reading Figures 3 and 10

1 – 4 (yellow, red, green, and blue) correspond to 1 – 4 phases of VLP approximation
Purple is for mapping softmax, and gray marks the additional hardware for GEMM

summary: Mugi is a value-level-parallelism (VLP) hardware architecture that accelerates both nonlinear operations (softmax, exp, SiLU/GELU) and GEMM in LLM inference. Figure 9 gives an overview of the Mugi chip: a main panel (a) shows off-chip memory feeding double-buffered iSRAM/wSRAM through wFIFO, CNT, iAcc and iFIFO into a PE array built from temporal converters (TC) and processing elements (PE), whose outputs pass through a post-processing unit (PP), output accumulator (oAcc), output FIFO and output SRAM, with an M-proc/E-proc pair and a Vec array handling softmax division. Seven smaller panels (b)-(h) zoom into specific circuit blocks such as the PE, TC, counter/PP pairing, and mux logic. The figure reuses a four-color scheme (yellow, red, green, blue) from the paper's algorithm figure to mark hardware for each of the four VLP approximation phases, plus purple for softmax-specific mapping hardware and gray for hardware needed only for standard GEMM, tying the circuit directly back to the algorithmic walkthrough.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Mugi 硬件架构总览：主图(a)展示片外存储器经双缓冲 SRAM、FIFO、计数器进入由 TC 和 PE 构成的脉动阵列，再经后处理、累加器、输出 SRAM 与向量单元完成 softmax 计算；(b)-(h) 为各电路模块细节。颜色沿用 VLP 四阶段配色（黄红绿蓝），紫色代表 softmax 映射硬件，灰色代表 GEMM 额外硬件。
notes: The main dataflow (off-chip memory to PE array to output stage) is directly supported by the text; some fine-grained wiring among sub-panel (b)-(h) circuit blocks is read from the figure itself since the prose focuses on Figure 10's walkthrough rather than every connection in Figure 9.
